reference_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date,'%Y-%m') AS month,ROUND(SUM(discount_amount),2) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 以 2026-09-12 为今天，最近69天按省份汇总有效订单数、销售额和付费用户数，返回省份和三个指标。
reference_sql: SELECT u.province,COUNT(*) AS order_count,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount,COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paying_users FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date>=DATE_SUB('2026-09-12',INTERVAL 69 DAY) GROUP BY u.province

question: 以 2026-09-12 为今天，最近39天按消费总额从高到低列出前4位客户，返回客户名称和该指标，同值按用户ID升序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS metric FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date>=DATE_SUB('2026-09-12',INTERVAL 39 DAY) GROUP BY u.user_id,u.user_name ORDER BY metric DESC,u.user_id ASC LIMIT 4
